# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to this project.

## Contribution Workflow
1. Create `feature/*` or `hotfix/*` branches based on `main`. **Do not push directly to protected branches**.
2. Follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for commit messages.
3. Build and run tests for the affected module (Backend / Frontend / Algorithm / Deploy) locally.
4. Open a Pull Request and complete the PR template. Use `Closes #issue‑number` to link related issues.
5. Wait for code review and all CI checks to pass. Keep your branch up‑to‑date with the target branch.
6. Resolve all review comments before merging.

## Pull Request Rules
- All CI jobs must pass
- At least one reviewer approval
- No unresolved conversation threads
- Only maintainers perform the final merge

## Issues
- Report bugs using the bug‑report template, include reproduction steps and environment details.
- Submit feature requests via the feature‑request template.
